protocol.checkpoint_selection: Smallest mean validation cross-entropy after an epoch; earliest epoch wins exact ties. Never evaluate test/challenge during fit.
protocol.determinism: Seed Python, NumPy and torch; deterministic torch algorithms; seeded independent shuffle generator; CPU float32. Reproduce full training once; report discrepancies rather than promising cross-platform bit equality.
protocol.evaluation: Compare frozen baseline v2 and selected transformer on identical 423 historical benchmark and 2000 challenge inputs. Freeze model/threshold before scoring. Report class metrics, FPR, balanced accuracy, source/origin subgroups, paired correctness, whole-group 1000-resample seed-42 intervals, token truncation and resource conditions. Current benchmarks are already inspected; final reserve is not used.
protocol.optimizer: AdamW; decay weights except bias and LayerNorm.weight. All encoder/head parameters train.
protocol.post_score_review: Review deterministic capped false-positive/false-negative and correct-control samples only after selection and scoring; record observations without retuning.
protocol.reproduction: Repeat training and benchmark scoring once under the unchanged protocol; independent counts and artifact integrity. No stage 6.
protocol.schedule: Linear warmup then linear decay to zero; one fixed configuration and seed, no hyperparameter search.
protocol.text: Use frozen real-mail-v2 subject/body and baseline marker removal; fixed uncased WordPiece tokenizer. Right truncate including special tokens, dynamic batch padding; record all truncation counts. No row dropped for length after the existing character contract.
protocol.threshold_selection: At the selected checkpoint use the unchanged baseline validation-only phishing-F1 grid and ties. Report fixed 0.50 as a prespecified diagnostic. No adjustment after benchmark results.

single_seed_limit: One fixed configuration/seed. Identical-seed reproduction tests execution, not variability across seeds.

source.attribution: Google BERT Miniatures; Turc et al., Well-Read Students Learn Better (2019). Publisher Apache-2.0 declaration.
limits: Upstream pretraining membership is unavailable; no verified non-overlap claim.
Small capacity and right truncation can miss important context.
No knowledge-distillation teacher is used in this study.
source.role: English uncased pretrained BERT encoder. Discard MLM/NSP heads; initialize a new two-class head and fine-tune every encoder/head parameter. No upstream phishing classifier is assumed.

study.benchmark_status: Previously scored data; retrospective comparison only. No fresh final-test or contemporary-inbox claim. Keep every inspected family outside benchmark scoring. No split regeneration.
study.reserve_policy: Original 703 rows stay byte-identical, unscored and unopened by train/evaluate. Before stage 9 freeze all model/threshold/attack/defense decisions and the final evaluation protocol; report reserve once without using it to choose a model or retune. Repeated technical reproduction is not a new independent test. Reserve remains source/era biased.
study.stage6_status: Not started; no perturbation generation, attacks, augmentation or defense.
